status: Validated against T3 Code's source-control docs, PR watch source, PR tool definitions and runtime instructions at pingdotgg/t3code da04ebc; one Codex Sol and Claude Opus review round; matched baseline and candidate decision probes on both hosts.
request: Also update pr-review-followup for T3 Code after pr-followup adopted T3's PR watch. The user chose watch_pull_request over the 30-minute schedule in T3 Code, the schedule elsewhere, and a separate PR.

changes.change: New T3 Code watch section: arm after a tick that ends waiting, with a resume line and the events the watch never reports; one tick per wake; unwatch before a tick that ends for the user, including progress that waits only on time or unreported events; schedule fallback when arming fails or the user names an interval; once-per-change blocker reports for both modes.
First tick runs immediately with cadence.md deciding how to wait; one pointer at the end of each tick to keep or stop waiting; a user-requested retry of a failed review with begin.
The cadence invariant records the 2026-10-29 user decision; two new invariants for handback and unreported events; T3 Code reference documents.
pr-review-followup runs on T3 watch changes in T3 Code and every 30 minutes elsewhere.

not_adopted.reason: A rule against replying to a bot's answer is outside the waiting change; T3 Code's comment-only stop bounds a reply loop.
